facts.fact: The queen pays a death-gift to border soldiers' widows at harvest; Parukutty's debt falls due three months before it.
The salt factor adds a tally fee once a debt passes a month.
Four soldiers' widows on the wall rolls owe the salt factor. Devan says he will clear the other three by the new moon, and tells no one.
Unni is not much past twenty.
Ammu has a new nick across one knuckle, a planted detail for a later chapter to pay off or drop.
The Resin House punishes telling a member what the masters have not, which is why Ammu stops herself.
Ammu ties the pepper packet with a fisherman's double hitch, learned by both girls from a net-mender behind the sheds as children.
At the end of ch7 Neela decides to leave a written question about the 'way' under the meeting stone that night.
Ammu, 25, says Kirri (31) taught the younger girls their letters as the big girl and could not spell 'tide'.
